2: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
3: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
4: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
5: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
6: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
7: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
8: For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
9: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
10: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
